notes.title: New Update: Build v0.5.4.4
notes.content:
Howdy Gearheads!
I have uploaded build v0.5.4.4 and made it available to Testers. The road to Early Access release continues. This update includes a new Custom Music Player. This allows you to play your own music while racing. I know that not everyone will want to listen to the OST so this made perfect sense.

Next Update will add Garage Customization.

Thank you for your continued support!

More Updates soon!
-Foamy

tags.feature: This update includes a new Custom Music Player.
